comparison.objective: Turn a drum on its side and roll it into an angled bay; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual counter-directed end forces to steer rolling versus fine fastener/collar manipulation and iterative axial impact testing.
comparison.success_condition: Drum rolled—not merely slid—between rails to the back bar, released, and held for one second versus two safe, repeatable carriage stops.
comparison.reason: Both depend on physical dynamics, but controlled rolling and steering test a different ability from tuning and locking passive damping.
